data.body: **[P2] Preserve continuation retry control when an End hook fails.** A checkpoint-continuation fatal is wrapped in a retryable `UnrecoverableDurableExecutionException`, but an unisolated End-hook `Error` exits here before that control exception is rethrown. The caller consequently loses the retry type and original fatal cause. Combine the failures using the existing fatal-precedence rules, then rethrow the selected retry control; add a continuation-fatal plus failing-End regression test.
